# BabyPeek

> BabyPeek is an AI future baby photo generator and AI baby predictor. Upload two parent photos and it dreams up what your baby could look like — a free sneak peek, then a $5 one-time unlock for the full portrait.

## What it is
- Entertainment product: an AI imagines a baby portrait blending visible features from two photos. It is NOT a genetic prediction, medical advice, or a promise of what any child will look like.
- Built by MehyarSoft. Live at https://baby.mehyar.us/

## How it works
1. Upload two clear face photos (you and your partner, or any two people).
2. Vision AI (Llama 3.2 Vision) studies eyes, hair, skin tone, and face shape from each photo.
3. Image AI (FLUX) generates a photorealistic baby portrait blending both sets of traits, plus a separate faceless "tiny hand" teaser.
4. You see the free teaser instantly. Enter your email and pay $5 (one-time, Stripe) to unlock and download the full high-resolution portrait.

## Pricing
- Free: AI teaser (faceless sneak peek of your baby).
- $5 one-time: full high-resolution baby portrait + instant download. No subscription.

## Privacy
- Parent photos are processed in memory and never stored.
- Only the AI-generated baby images are kept (to show back to you).
- Email addresses are stored for unlock delivery and product updates; every marketing email carries a one-click unsubscribe link.

## FAQ
- **Is this a real prediction of my future child?** No — pure entertainment. Genetics is beautifully unpredictable.
- **What do I get for $5?** The full high-res portrait + instant download. One-time payment, no subscription.
- **Are my photos stored?** No. Uploads are processed in memory and never saved.
- **How long does it take?** About 30 seconds from upload to sneak peek; unlocking is instant after checkout.
